entries.title: Book II: The Ligaments and Muscles
entries.content:
"Il movimento è armonia di forze."
(Movement is the harmony of forces.)

entries.title: Book II: The Ligaments and Muscles
entries.content: Stillness gives way to motion. Muscles and ligaments are no longer confused—muscles act, ligaments stabilise.

entries.title: Book II: The Ligaments and Muscles
entries.content: Movement depends on coordination and balance between opposing actions—forces working together rather than alone.

entries.title: Book II: The Ligaments and Muscles
entries.content: "I am not so much concerned with the muscles as with the movements they produce." — Andreas Vesalius
